name: Rowan County, NC
findings: Rowan County has 342 nonprofit organizations. 126 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 101 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rowan County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 22 would.

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 35 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
